# Vozen

> Vozen offers three Discord bots: TTS reads chat aloud, Music plays curated stations in voice channels, and Helper handles moderation, tickets and community tools.

The core features are free. Vozen Plus adds personal perks for TTS and Music. Vozen Premium unlocks server-wide perks across all three bots in selected servers. See the plans page for current prices and inclusions.

## Products

- [Vozen ecosystem](https://vozen.org/): overview of all three bots.
- [Vozen TTS](https://vozen.org/tts/): read Discord chat aloud, try voice samples and learn to set up automatic reading.
- [Vozen Music](https://vozen.org/music/): preview curated music stations and learn to listen together in a Discord voice channel.
- [Vozen Helper](https://vozen.org/helper/): protect and manage your server with moderation, tickets, roles and workflows.

## Commands, plans and support

- [Commands](https://vozen.org/commands/): browse the command catalogue by bot.
- [Plans](https://vozen.org/premium): compare Free, Plus and Premium across the three bots.
- [Status](https://vozen.org/status): check service availability.
- [Discord support server](https://discord.gg/4kYw2WUbNN): get help with setup and troubleshooting.
